# CodeSparring - AI-Powered Technical Interview Practice
# https://codesparring.dev

> CodeSparring is an AI-powered platform that helps software engineers prepare for technical interviews through realistic mock interviews with intelligent feedback.

## What We Do

CodeSparring provides:
- **AI Mock Interviews**: Practice coding interviews with an AI interviewer that simulates real FAANG-style technical interviews
- **Spaced Repetition Learning**: Scientifically-proven review scheduling to maximize retention of DSA patterns
- **Personalized Roadmaps**: Custom study plans based on target company, interview date, and skill level
- **Real-time Feedback**: Get instant feedback on code correctness, communication, and problem-solving approach
- **Pattern-Based Learning**: Master 15+ DSA patterns (arrays, trees, graphs, DP, etc.) used in top tech interviews

## Key Features

- Voice-enabled mock interviews with AI interviewer
- Smart notifications for optimal practice timing
- Progress tracking with streak and milestone gamification
- Company-specific preparation (Google, Meta, Amazon, etc.)
- Behavioral interview practice
- Code execution and test case validation

## Target Audience

- Software engineers preparing for technical interviews
- Bootcamp graduates entering the job market
- Career switchers moving into software development
- Engineers targeting FAANG/top tech companies

## Core Technology

- Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Firebase
- AI-powered by Claude (Anthropic) for natural interview conversations
- Uses proven spaced repetition algorithms (SM-2, FSRS) for learning optimization
